stages.name: Discovery
stages.description: Intercept a repeating 142.5 MHz distress beacon from the Regional Communications Array. The signal pattern is military — but the voice sounds civilian.

stages.name: Investigation
stages.description: Send an expedition to the Communications Array to repair the antenna and locate the signal source room. The transmitter is still running on backup power.

stages.name: Crisis
stages.description: The signal is an automated death loop from a deceased technician — but a trapped civilian family is in the basement below a collapsing roof.

branch_a.label: Dismantle the Array
branch_a.description: Strip the array for vacuum tubes and copper wiring. Gain high scrap value. The family dies.

branch_b.label: Rescue the Family
branch_b.description: Use tools to shore up the basement and rescue the family. Lose expedition time. Gain 2 survivors.

stages.name: Resolution
stages.description: The rescued survivors join the shelter, or the dismantled parts unlock advanced radio intercept capabilities.

stages.name: Discovery
stages.description: The Water Purity Gauge reports a sudden 40% spike in heavy metal contamination. The source must be upstream.

stages.name: Investigation
stages.description: Dispatch a team to the Flooded Water Treatment Plant to inspect the intake valves. Someone has been here recently.

stages.name: Crisis
stages.description: A sabotaged chemical barrel was dumped into the main intake pipe by a hostile raider faction. The contamination is spreading.

branch_a.label: Neutralize with Medicine
branch_a.description: Use 3 antibiotics to neutralize the chemical contamination. Restores full water purity.

branch_b.label: Seal the Intake Permanently
branch_b.description: Seal the primary intake pipe permanently. Avoids medicine cost but lowers daily water output by 50%.

stages.name: Resolution
stages.description: The shelter water system stabilizes. The daily water yield is determined by the crisis choice — full purification or permanent rationing.
